Summarise the following engineering notes as 12 concise bullet points, then list the three biggest open risks.

# DFlash 2 on Ternary Bonsai 2 27B — plan (2026-09-18)

Tier: **Lab** (research legs under `/lab-nt`), promoting into LocalMind (Product tier) only at the end of stage 2.
Goal: lossless speculative decoding for LocalMind's 27B slot. Stage 1 proves it on MLX with existing runtimes; stage 2 ports it into the vendored WebGPU engine.

Chirag, 2026-09-18: "do dflash on mlx as well, as step 1. then crack webgpu and the like."

---

## What is known (evidence gathered 2026-09-18, all `reported` unless marked)

**Drafter exists for exactly this base.**
- `z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2` — 5 Qwen3-style layers (hidden 5120, 32/8 heads, head_dim 128, sliding window 2048, intermediate 17408), `target_layer_ids [5, 19, 33, 47, 61]`, `block_size 8` (7 draft tokens), `selector_rank 256`, `selector_top_k 16`, `conv_kernel_size 2`, `conv_group_size 16`, `mask_token_id 248070`. Shares the target's embed + lm_head. bf16 safetensors 3.85 GB; official GGUF `z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-GGUF` at Q4_K_M 1.14 GB / Q8_0 2.06 GB / BF16 3.86 GB. Apache-2.0.
- Transfers to the ternary target unchanged: `nathansutton/Qwen3.8-27B-Ternary-Bonsai-2-DFlash2-MLX` reports 94 % of drafted tokens accepted, 21 → 64 tok/s on an M4 Pro (their `chad` runtime, not mlx-lm). The drafter reads the residual stream, which the ternary quant only mildly perturbs.
- Reference implementations: `z-lab/dflash` (`model.py`, `model_mlx.py` — both v1 and v2, hook-based hidden capture, GDN state re-execution on rollback); `bstnxbt/dflash-mlx` (Apple-Silicon runtime; upstream `origin/main` @ `6080323` 2026-08-20 has `feat(draft): support Qwen3.8 DFlash2 drafts`, `engine/target_qwen_gdn.py` with tape-replay recurrent rollback, W4 draft quantisation via Metal MMA kernels, registry row `("Qwen3.8-27B",) → z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2, hybrid_gdn, W4_DEFAULTS`); `ARahim3/mlx-dspark` (DSpark + DFlash on MLX; ternary Bonsai **v1** at 1.07× with PrismML's DSpark head; Qwen3.8-27B-4bit + DFlash2 at 2.30×, 5.14 tokens/round, cap 7); llama.cpp PR #27342 (DFlash2 merged 2026-08-27: grouped dynamic depthwise conv `out[i,c] = Σ_t (base[t,c] + δ[i,t,g(c)]) · x[i−t,c]`, selector `edge(p→c) = ⟨A[p] ⊙ project(h), B[c]⟩ + unary[c]`, greedy path with `p_min`; Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M on M5 Pro 1.85×, acceptance 4.92).
- Field numbers disagree on ternary targets: PrismML's CUDA path 1.8–2.4× (ternary v1, DSpark), their Metal note ~1.2× on code/math and slower elsewhere; mlx-dspark 1.07× on ternary v1 ("extra verify rows on a 2-bit model are compute-bound"); chad 3× on Bonsai 2 with DFlash2. The variable is verify cost per extra row on the ternary kernel, which is exactly what stage 0 measures.

**Local assets (verified on this box 2026-09-18).**
- `~/.cache/huggingface/hub/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-mlx-2bit/` — PrismML's MLX pack, 8.6 GB `model.safetensors`, `model_type prism_hadamard_qwen35`, `quantization {bits 2, group_size 128, affine}`, bundled `runtime/` (`artifact.load_model(dir)` builds a stock `mlx_lm.models.qwen3_5.TextModel` and swaps every Linear / the embedding for a `Packed` module = blockwise Hadamard `fwht` on activations + `mx.quantized_matmul(bits=2, group_size=128)`). Pins `mlx==0.32.0 mlx-lm==0.31.3` (box has 0.31.1 / 0.31.1 → needs its own venv). Downloaded 20:48–21:00 tonight; `runtime/__pycache__` at 21:58 means it has been run once.
- `~/Code/dflash-mlx` — clone of `bstnxbt/dflash-mlx` at the April `19303f6` (v1 only, Qwen3.5); ~100 commits behind. Chirag's `NOTES.md` (Gemma 4 draft-training TODO) and a triage sweep in `plan/`.
- Hardware: Apple M4 Pro, 24 GB unified. Budget: target 8.6 GB + W4 draft ≈ 1.2 GB + caches. Do not run the WebGPU (5.95 GB GPU-resident) and the MLX target at the same time.
- Vendored WebGPU engine `ternary_bonsai_2_27b.js` (`inferred` from the minified source): `specDecodeRunner(){return null}` stub; prefill graph already taps chosen layers into a `dspark.features` scratch `[T, taps·hidden]` via `com.xenova.StridedCopy` and scaffolds per-position `dspark.conv_snapshots`, all gated on a spec config object nobody passes; `CandidateArgMax` + `LlamaDecodeLmHeadRescore` = a top-k lm_head scan/rescore pipeline; greedy only (`X0` throws on `do_sample`); hybrid cache truncates only to 0 / full / `rewindPointLength`; short-prefill planner replays anything `< shortBlock=16` one decode step at a time; GGUF type table includes Q4_K/Q8_0 (dequant kernel coverage unverified).

---

## Stage 0 — the number that decides the WebGPU stage  (tonight, ~1 h wall, mostly download)

Verify cost on the WebGPU ternary path: time a 16-token graph prefill on top of a cached prefix versus one decode step, on the vendored engine, real Chrome, tab foregrounded.

- Protocol: live origin, main-thread `import('/ternary_bonsai_2_27b.js')` after the app has cached the weights (app picker → Bonsai 2 started 2026-09-18 ~22:10; the MCP Chrome profile had lost yesterday's cache — storage 0 MB, disk 94 % full). Load with `maxLength 4096`; `streamTokens({suffixIds: 256 tokens, maxNewTokens: 1})` to seed; then median of 3 for suffix = 1 (decode step), 8 (replay path), 16 (shortBlock graph), 32 (bucket) with `maxNewTokens: 1`; plus steady-state decode tok/s over 32 tokens.
- Verifier: the ratio `t(16-token step) / t(1-token step)`. Under ~2 → stage 2 is worth it (acceptance ~5 → 2×+). Over ~5 → WebGPU DFlash is dead on this backend; stage 1 still stands on its own (MLX users, and a LocalMind `local endpoint` backend pointing at `dflash serve`).
- Owed: reload the tab to the default model after the download so the app's worker frees the GPU copy before the harness loads its own.

**Stage 0 result, pass 1 (observed 2026-09-20 ~17:40, real Chrome relaunched after the memory thrash, tab visible for every step, MLX idle, model from the IDB cache):** `streamTokens` first-token latency is flat at **~1.44 s for N = 1 / 8 / 16 / 32** (medians 1439.5 / 1452.8 / 1434.4 / 1444.3 ms, spreads under 50 ms) while the steady decode step i

- `~/Code/dflash-mlx` — clone of `bstnxbt/dflash-mlx` at the April `19303f6` (v1 only, Qwen3.5); ~100 commits behind. Chirag's `NOTES.md` (Gemma 4 draft-training TODO) and a triage sweep in `plan/`.
- Hardware: Apple M4 Pro, 24 GB unified. Budget: target 8.6 GB + W4 draft ≈ 1.2 GB + caches. Do not run the WebGPU (5.95 GB GPU-resident) and the MLX target at the same time.
- Vendored WebGPU engine `ternary_bonsai_2_27b.js` (`inferred` from the minified source): `specDecodeRunner(){return null}` stub; prefill graph already taps chosen layers into a `dspark.features` scratch `[T, taps·hidden]` via `com.xenova.StridedCopy` and scaffolds per-position `dspark.conv_snapshots`, all gated on a spec config object nobody passes; `CandidateArgMax` + `LlamaDecodeLmHeadRescore` = a top-k lm_head scan/rescore pipeline; greedy only (`X0` throws on `do_sample`); hybrid cache truncates only to 0 / full / `rewindPointLength`; short-prefill planner replays anything `< shortBlock=16` one decode step at a time; GGUF type table includes Q4_K/Q8_0 (dequant kernel coverage unverified).
